correctness.rationale: For each even degree ell, the SU(2) matrix-coefficient harmonic kernel is K=(ell+1)U_ell(Re(q^-1p)) under Haar probability normalization. Restriction to H=2I/{±1}=A5 yields the 5-class character formula. Schur orthogonality independently reconstructs all Gram eigenvalues 60(ell+1)m_rho/d_rho of multiplicity d_rho², with sums 60 and diagonal (ell+1)². The exact 30-residue computation and identity m_rho(ell+60)=m_rho(ell)+d_rho prove every even degree, including the terminal rank defect ell=58 and permanent full rank from 60. Character constancy plus rank 59 uniquely yields G_58=3540(I-J/60). Projector inversion proves sample feasibility and minimum-norm interpolation. Reproduced standalone checker passed 20,155 exact/group-structural and finite numerical comparisons, including independent 60x60 eigenvalue calculations; finite tests are not used in the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical 600-cell antipodal sampling configuration. Knowing its 11-design strength or harmonic mean obstructions does not determine the pointwise image of a single harmonic degree. The theorem determines all five irreducible Gram sectors for every even degree, an infinite family of reconstruction maps, nonmonotone recovery and its permanent cutoff, and a unique equiconditioned codimension-one sampling degree. These are structural and operational interpolation facts, not a parameter-renaming or routine isolated table value. The shared harmonic/kernel and character-theory ingredients are credited rather than claimed novel.
